name: livt-discovery
description: The discovery ring of a livt repository: record a story-mapping or example-mapping session as text (the board verbatim), formulate the recorded mapping as a structural edit the review reads, write a story's card, change an agreed rule, and carry a proposed one to agreement — with expert skills for the Opportunity Canvas, User Story Mapping, and BDD Example Mapping
